name: BASSO Venta Disc
why_interesting: The price lead is for the discontinued Venta Disc generation, not the current Venta R, and remains suspiciously low enough to require exact-trim and seller verification.

facts.frame_material: Old-generation Venta Disc 100% UD Torayca TR50 and MR60 carbon monocoque frame with full-carbon Torayca TR50 fork
facts.frame_construction: Internal routing, 3B Gen2 seatpost-clamp system, BB86.5 press fit and 12 mm thru axles
facts.reference_builds: Documented 105 2x11/Microtech builds range from 8.5 to 9.05 kg and use 28 mm tires; an Ultegra option also existed. The retained listing does not identify which build, year or condition applies.
facts.stiffness_evidence: An independent exact-model road.cc test describes a very responsive frame with strong lower-frame stiffness and a comfortable rear end; qualitative ride evidence, not a numeric deflection result

missing: Exact model year, drivetrain, complete BOM, complete-bike weight and manufacturer-confirmed maximum tire clearance
source_note: Current Basso catalog results show the successor Venta R; old-generation Venta Disc sources are retained separately. Exact reference builds confirm TR50/MR60 construction and qualitative stiffness but conflict on complete weight and do not identify the CNY 6,888 listing's trim, condition or seller authority.
